messages:
maria_s: Quick coordination for Senior Infra Eng candidate (Jordan T.) arriving Fri 2026-05-09. Onsite window 09:30-13:30 PT. Need badge, parking, loaner, and quiet nook for coding task.
dave_l: ETA and travel mode?
maria_s: Driving from Bay Area, expects to arrive ~09:00. Asked about parking reimbursement.
priya: Expense code OPS-INT-TRAVEL, cap $50 for parking. DM bank/venmo for stipend early payout?
maria_s: Recruiter will DM details by EOD.
ellie_ops: Reception will have a greeter. Please confirm ID upload and NDA.
candidate_portal: Candidate packet reminder sent. Upload link: https://portal.redwood.example/upload. Deadline 48h prior.
peopleops_bot: Onsite checklist created: room reserve, badge, loaner, accessibility, parking code. Reminder 24h before.
dave_l: Room request: Quiet Lab 2 reserved 09:15-13:45 for buffer and pairing. Has HDMI and whiteboard.
priya: Loaner: 15" Linux laptop available. IT will create guest account and preinstall VS Code + Docker.
maria_s: Candidate requested standing desk and lower glare lighting due to neck strain.
ellie_ops: NotedStanding desk and lamp will be set. Headphones available.
dave_l: Confirm recordings off and no live streaming.
maria_s: Agreed. Also ask panelists to avoid panels longer than 45m; include 10-min breaks.
peopleops_bot: Calendar invite sent to panelists and candidate with 30m and 15m reminders. Invite ID: 1945678901-INFRA-JORDAN.
priya: Lunch voucher: vegetarian and gluten-free options requested. Sending digital codes to recruiter.
dave_l: Please post day-of ops contact in the channel.
ellie_ops: Posted ops contact +1-650-555-0199. Reception to call if issues.
maria_s: One more: candidate asked about restrooms near Quiet Lab 2. Confirmed accessible restroom on same floor.
priya: All set. Will confirm stipend payout and send pickup notes to recruiter.
maria_s: Thanks team. Recruiter will update arrival ETA tomorrow.
ellie_ops: We'll have badge and desk ready.
peopleops_bot: Accessibility accommodations logged. Reminder to send arrival instructions 24h prior.
maria_s: Perfect, :thumbsup:
